name: Start Idea Workspace
purpose: Open a persistent space for non-authoritative exploration.
whenToUse: At project start or whenever creative exploration returns.
requiredContext: The creator's current question or idea.
expectedOutput: Useful exploration and, when requested, a candidate Idea Brief.
stopConditions: Do not treat discussion as approved truth.

name: Start Game Design Workspace
purpose: Create the persistent design workspace.
whenToUse: After Idea Brief approval.
requiredContext: Approved Idea-Brief.md.
stopConditions: Stop if the Idea Brief is unapproved or materially incomplete.

name: Start Architecture Workspace
purpose: Create the persistent architecture workspace.
whenToUse: After Game Design Brief approval.
requiredContext: Approved Game Design Brief and relevant Bible truth.
stopConditions: Stop when game-level design is unresolved.

name: Start Module Workspace
purpose: Create one retained Work chat for a module.
whenToUse: After Architecture approves the module.
requiredContext: Architecture, Module Map entry and relevant Bible truth.
expectedOutput: A module workspace ready for Module Agent activation.
stopConditions: Stop if module ownership is not approved.

name: Start Codex Module Workspace
purpose: Create one retained implementation chat for a module.
whenToUse: When the module readiness gate passes.
requiredContext: Repository AGENTS.md, repository reality and approved module sources.
stopConditions: Stop if module readiness is incomplete.

name: Activate Design Agent
purpose: Transform an approved idea into architecture-ready game design.
whenToUse: Within the Game Design Workspace.
requiredContext: Approved Idea Brief.
stopConditions: Pause for missing creator intent or approval.

name: Activate Architecture Agent
purpose: Derive capabilities, authority, dependencies and module boundaries.
whenToUse: Within the Architecture Workspace or for architecture-impacting change.
requiredContext: Approved Game Design Brief and relevant Bible truth.
stopConditions: Pause when design truth is conflicting or incomplete.

name: Activate Module Agent
purpose: Define complete requirements for one approved module.
whenToUse: At the first phase of a Module Workspace or for fundamental module change.
requiredContext: Architecture, Module Map entry and Bible truth.
stopConditions: Do not slice while material requirements remain unresolved.

name: Switch Module Workspace to Slice Agent
purpose: Transition an approved module from requirements to slicing.
whenToUse: After Module Requirements approval in the same Work chat.
requiredContext: Approved Module Requirements.
expectedOutput: Complete Slice Map and approved Slice specifications.
stopConditions: Stop if requirements are unapproved or incomplete.

name: Activate Bible Maintenance Agent
purpose: Initialise or update authoritative design truth.
whenToUse: After approved design truth is created or changed.
requiredContext: Creator-approved design sources.
stopConditions: Report conflicts; do not resolve or approve them.

name: Activate Validation Agent
purpose: Independently compare evidence with specification.
whenToUse: At meaningful Slice, Module, integration, prototype or milestone points.
requiredContext: Authoritative specification and implementation evidence.
expectedOutput: Pass, Pass With Deviations, Fail or Blocked.
stopConditions: Return Blocked when truth is unclear or evidence is insufficient.

name: Use Project Librarian
purpose: Retrieve minimum current authoritative context.
whenToUse: Whenever a role needs targeted source retrieval.
requiredContext: A precise context request and known project relationships.
expectedOutput: Current sources, deprecated distinctions and reported conflicts.
stopConditions: Never resolve conflicts, approve or modify truth.

name: Compile Idea Brief
purpose: Turn selected exploration into a creator-reviewable brief.
whenToUse: When an idea is coherent enough to propose for design.
requiredContext: Selected discussion and creator constraints.
stopConditions: Do not mark authoritative without creator approval.

name: Create Game Design Brief
purpose: Document architecture-ready game design.
whenToUse: During the Game Design Workspace.
requiredContext: Approved Idea Brief and resolved design decisions.
stopConditions: Pause on material experience ambiguity.

name: Initialise Game Design Bible
purpose: Create authoritative homes for current approved design truth.
whenToUse: After initial Game Design approval.
requiredContext: Approved Game Design Brief.
stopConditions: Do not invent future content or resolve contradictions.

name: Run Capability Impact Check
purpose: Route an approved change to its highest affected ownership level.
whenToUse: After owning design truth is updated.
requiredContext: Approved change and current Architecture/Module Map.
stopConditions: Escalate when ownership cannot be established.

name: Check Module Implementation Readiness
purpose: Determine whether one module may enter production.
whenToUse: After requirements and slicing are complete.
requiredContext: Architecture, Module Map, Requirements, Slice Map, Slice specifications, contracts and validation expectations.
expectedOutput: Ready or a precise missing-condition list.
stopConditions: Never infer project-wide readiness from one module.

name: Begin Slice Implementation
purpose: Start repository-aware implementation of one approved Slice.
whenToUse: Inside the retained Codex module workspace.
requiredContext: Repository reality, AGENTS.md, Architecture, Requirements and current Slice.
expectedOutput: Inspect-first technical plan, implementation and evidence.
stopConditions: Stop on missing truth, ownership crossing or collision risk.

name: Resume Module Workspace
purpose: Return to retained module reasoning with current truth.
whenToUse: For requirements or slicing changes.
requiredContext: Current authoritative status, owning module and affected Slice.
expectedOutput: Current position and next approved specification action.
stopConditions: Historical chat must not override current documents.

name: Resume Codex Module Workspace
purpose: Return to retained implementation context safely.
whenToUse: For an approved implementation change or next Slice.
requiredContext: Current specification, repository state and latest evidence.
expectedOutput: Current position and next valid implementation action.
stopConditions: Inspect repository before continuing.

name: Validate Slice
purpose: Compare a completed Slice with its specification.
whenToUse: After self-validation.
requiredContext: Slice specification and implementation evidence.
stopConditions: Return Blocked when evidence or truth is insufficient.

name: Validate Module
purpose: Confirm completed Slices form a coherent Module implementation.
whenToUse: At Module completion.
requiredContext: Module Requirements, all Slice results and integration evidence.
stopConditions: Do not substitute individual Slice passes for module coherence.

name: Propagate Approved Change
purpose: Carry updated truth through every affected downstream level.
whenToUse: After the Capability Impact Check.
requiredContext: Approved change, impact route and affected sources.
stopConditions: Travel upward only as far as necessary; do not skip affected levels.

name: Resolve Blocked Work
purpose: Return a blocker to the level owning unclear or conflicting truth.
whenToUse: After a Blocked validation or agent stop.
requiredContext: Conflict, evidence and last trusted state.
expectedOutput: Resolved truth, deliberate deferral or revised boundary.
stopConditions: Do not patch implementation around unresolved authority.
